0022600139.text: The Golden State Warriors (1-3, 4th in the Pacific, 12th in the West) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (3-1, 3rd in the Northwest, 6th in the West) for their fifth game of the season, and the Warriors enter on a one-game winning streak. Golden State is without Gui Santos (knee tendinitis), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Warriors lost 1-3, including a 127-117 loss to Minnesota on March 13, 2026 in San Francisco.
